full_name: Paul Steinhardt | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Physical Sciences Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow Princeton University
bio: Paul Steinhardt is a theoretical physicist whose research ranges from the origin, evolution, and future of the universe to new states of matter. He is the Albert Einstein Professor in Science and director of the Princeton Center for Theoretical Science at Princeton University, where he is also on the faculty of both the Department of Physics and the Department of Astrophysical Sciences.
